identity.title: List of Pokémon Pocket Monsters volumes

leadText:
This is a list of volumes of the Pokémon Pocket Monsters manga created by 穴久保幸作 Kosaku Anakubo. There are fourteen volumes in total, all of which have been translated into English by Chuang Yi.

 

 

 
 

it:Elenco dei volumi di Pokémon Pocket Monsters
